description: This PHP source file defines the cfield_mgr class responsible for managing custom fields in the TestLink project. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving custom field definitions, as well as handling the storage and retrieval of custom field values at various stages such as design, execution, and test plan design. The class also manages configuration settings related to custom fields, including types, display locations, and associated node types. Additionally, it contains logic for rendering HTML input elements for custom fields and for linking custom fields to test projects.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: This class manages custom fields operations including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and display functionalities within the TestLink system.
